fields.title: Target dimensions
fields.description: Select the number of dimensions the input data is projected to.

fields.title: Number of dimensions
fields.description: The number of dimensions to reduce the data to.

fields.title: Information preservation (%)
fields.description: The minimum percentage of information to preserve in the reduced dimensions.

fields.title: Columns
fields.description: Select the columns that are included by the PCA, i.e the original features.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove original data columns
fields.description: If checked, the columns containing the input data are removed.

fields.title: Fail if missing values are encountered
fields.description:
If checked, execution fails, when the selected columns contain missing values. By default, rows
containing missing values are ignored and not considered during the computation.
